# Advisories the npm and bun lockfile audits (security.yml) skip.
#
# One GHSA ID per line; text after `#` is the reason. Only list an advisory
# that has no patched release to move to, record why it cannot be reached
# or how it is mitigated in the published package, and remove the line once a
# fix ships: the npm audit job warns when an entry no longer matches anything.

# braces <= 3.0.3: stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. No patched
# version exists (3.0.3 is the latest release). Dev tooling (@changesets/cli and
# jscpd via micromatch) expands repository-controlled patterns. Runtime ShellJS
# uses js/src/shelljs/glob-safety.cjs: before fast-glob's synchronous entry points
# it bounds pattern length and combined brace/parenthesis AST depth, including
# ignore patterns. js/tests/shelljs-glob-safety.test.mjs reproduces the advisory
# in a bounded child and verifies rejection before recursive parsing. Direct
# imports of braces or fast-glob's async API are outside this mitigation.
# Dependency review uses this same single advisory exception in security.yml.
# Remove the exception and guard together when a patched release ships.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
